description: Memory-only test case 2. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I joined a yoga retreat with my friend Emma last weekend, and it was a rejuvenating experience practicing in such a serene environment.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I joined a yoga retreat with my friend Emma last weekend, and it was a rejuvenating experience practicing in such a serene environment.
steps.agent_response:
That sounds lovely — I’m glad you had a rejuvenating time! Would you like help turning that into an email or note? I can draft or send one for you. Here are a couple of short templates you can use or edit; tell me which to send or save as a draft (and whether to attach photos):

1) Message to Emma
- Subject: Loved the retreat — thank you!
- Body: Hey Emma — thank you for joining me at the retreat last weekend. Practicing in that serene setting was exactly what I needed, and I loved sharing it with you. Let’s plan another weekend like that soon! — [Your name]

2) Message to the retreat organizers / instructor
- Subject: Thank you for a wonderful retreat
- Body: Hello [Organizer/Instructor name], thank you for such a rejuvenating weekend. The location, instruction, and schedule were perfect — I left feeling refreshed and inspired. Please share any upcoming events or materials from the retreat. Best, [Your name]

Which would you like me to do: draft one, send one now, or just save these for you? If sending, tell me the recipient(s) and any photos or tweaks.
